confirm_dialog@reload_page.description: Confirm dialog shown when the page was opened before the extension was installed, updated or re-enabled, so it has to be reloaded before an image can be opened. Keep "SwiftView" untranslated.
confirm_dialog@reload_page.message: SwiftView can't open images on this page until it's reloaded. Reload now?

context_menu@open_image.description: Context menu item on an image. Opens the image with the viewer. Keep "SwiftView" untranslated.

extension@description.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page. At most 132 characters.
extension@description.message: Opens an image in a viewer on the same page from its context menu. Supports zoom, pan, rotate and flip.

extension@name.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page. Keep "SwiftView" untranslated.

viewer@image_error.description: Shown in the viewer in place of an image that failed to load.
